nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 storing token balances, located in StandardToken.
Nested mapping address => address => uint256 storing spending allowances in StandardToken.
Public uint256 total token supply declared in StandardToken.
Public string token name in ERC20Token ('Rainbow Token').
Public uint8 number of decimals in ERC20Token (18).
Public string token symbol in ERC20Token ('RNBO').
Public string version identifier in ERC20Token ('H1.1').
Abstract totalSupply() declaration of the Token interface.
Abstract balanceOf(address) declaration of the Token interface.
Abstract transfer(address,uint256) declaration of the Token interface.
Abstract transferFrom(address,address,uint256) declaration of the Token interface.
Abstract approve(address,uint256) declaration of the Token interface.
Abstract allowance(address,address) declaration of the Token interface.
StandardToken.transfer: moves _value from msg.sender to _to after balance check, updates balances and emits Transfer.
StandardToken.transferFrom: moves _value from _from to _to using caller allowance, updates balances/allowed and emits Transfer.
StandardToken.balanceOf: returns balances[_owner].
StandardToken.approve: sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
StandardToken.allowance: returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
ERC20Token fallback function that immediately throws on plain ether transfers.
ERC20Token constructor: mints initial balances[msg.sender], sets totalSupply, name, decimals and symbol.
approveAndCall: sets allowance and performs a low-level call to _spender's receiveApproval callback.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and callback argument.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value in transfer: unchecked arithmetic state mutation.
balances[_to] += _value in transfer: unchecked addition that can overflow.
balances[_to] += _value in transferFrom: unchecked addition that can overflow.
balances[_from] -= _value in transferFrom: unchecked subtraction state mutation.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom: unchecked allowance decrement.
Low-level _spender.call(receiveApproval selector, msg.sender, _value, this, _extraData) external call with arbitrary target.
_to recipient argument of StandardToken.transfer.
_value amount argument of StandardToken.transfer.
_from source address argument of StandardToken.transferFrom.
_to recipient address argument of StandardToken.transferFrom.
_value amount argument of StandardToken.transferFrom.
_owner address argument of StandardToken.balanceOf.
_spender address argument of StandardToken.approve.
_value amount argument of StandardToken.approve.
_owner address argument of StandardToken.allowance.
_spender address argument of StandardToken.allowance.
_spender address argument of ERC20Token.approveAndCall, target of the external callback.
_value amount argument of ERC20Token.approveAndCall.
_extraData bytes argument forwarded to the receiveApproval callback.

edges.reason: transfer executes balances[msg.sender] -= _value without safe math checks.
transfer executes balances[_to] += _value which can overflow on 0.4.x.
transferFrom executes balances[_to] += _value before any overflow guard.
transferFrom executes balances[_from] -= _value without underflow protection.
transferFrom decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender] unchecked.
approveAndCall always reaches the low-level call to the attacker-supplied _spender contract.
The low-level call invokes receiveApproval on _spender, an external callback able to re-enter the token.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping for reads and writes.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
msg.sender keys the balance decremented in transfer.
msg.sender keys the allowance decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument into the external receiveApproval call.
transfer's _value parameter flows into the unchecked subtraction of the sender balance.
transfer's _value parameter flows into the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
transferFrom's _value flows into the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
transferFrom's _value flows into the unchecked subtraction of the source balance.
transferFrom's _value flows into the unchecked allowance decrement.
transferFrom's _from parameter selects the balance mapping slot being decremented.
transferFrom's _to parameter selects the balance mapping slot being incremented.
The user-supplied _spender address determines the target of the external call.
_value is forwarded as an argument of the receiveApproval external call.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed allowance mapping.
balanceOf returns the value stored in the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the value stored in the allowed mapping.
Constructor mints the initial supply into balances[msg.sender].
Constructor assigns the initial value of totalSupply.
Constructor sets the token name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets the token symbol state variable.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed mapping before the external call.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the balances mapping entry for msg.sender.
Unchecked addition mutates the balances mapping entry for _to.
Unchecked addition mutates the balances mapping entry for _to in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the balances mapping entry for _from.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the allowance stored in the allowed mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only consumed inside StandardToken.transfer as the recipient mapping key.
_value of transfer feeds the unchecked addition on balances[_to].
_from of transferFrom selects the balance slot reduced by the unchecked subtraction.
_to of transferFrom selects the balance slot increased by the unchecked addition.
_value of transferFrom drives the unchecked allowance decrement.
_owner is only used to index balances in the balanceOf view function.
_spender is only used as the allowance key written by approve.
_value is only stored as the approved allowance inside approve.
_owner is only used to index the allowed mapping in allowance.
_spender is only used to index the allowed mapping in allowance.
_spender determines the target contract of the low-level receiveApproval call.
_value is forwarded as an argument of the external call.
_extraData is forwarded unchecked into the external call payload.
